title: Test-Time Coverage: Test-Conditioned Data Curation for Deployment-Aware Learning
mechanism: Select a budgeted training subset whose concept distribution matches unlabelled deployment samples.
adaptation: Simple EL descriptors (half-cut, mono/multi, busbar count, scuff, contrast) from pool and F51/H36 (not E1); select matching pool cells, pseudo-label, train.
min_experiment: Arm: 1,000 descriptor-matched pool cells pseudo-labelled. Baseline: 1,000 random pool cells, same teacher. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2. Kill: no gain vs random.
evidence: R: better coverage and end-to-end driving performance than curation baselines; distant domain.
prior_overlap: Pool SSL used uniform pool; target-matched curation not run. Open.
